name: Oren Isacson
biography: is an Exploit Writer and Researcher at Core Security Technologies. He has been interested in computer programming since an early age. He has been writing exploits, researching vulnerabilities, and researching exploitation methods for three years. He has written exploits for the Windows, Linux, AIX, Solaris, OpenBSD, and FreeBSD platforms. Previously, he worked as a security consultant doing penetration testing and writing security-related software.
